units.source_text: 阿清幻想着自己的葬礼。
吾八则希望开一家小饭馆。

en.t: Gohachi, for his part, hoped to open a small eatery.

units.source_text: 说实话，他这种希望能在去世以前实现就好了。

en.t: To be honest, it would be enough if that wish of his could come true before he died.

units.source_text: 他竟安心于这家旅馆，或去挖山芋，或去钓钓鱼，或由着性子回到邻村自己的家中……

en.t: Unexpectedly, he settled comfortably into life at this inn, sometimes going to dig mountain yams, sometimes going fishing, and sometimes returning on a whim to his own home in the neighboring village...

units.source_text: 从某种意义上说，这是一种老来的乐趣。

en.t: In a certain sense, this was one of the pleasures of old age.

units.source_text: 当年那股子麻利劲，现在仅仅表现在他在这家旅馆起床最早上。

en.t: The brisk efficiency he had once had now showed itself only in the fact that he rose earlier than anyone else at this inn.
